scope.statement: Synthetic assessment of the business-critical cloud identity, email, finance SaaS, managed laptops, public website and backup arrangements.
scope.minimumStandardsScopeRationale: The screen prioritises the listed business-critical and externally facing systems. Supplier-managed controls are considered only where the synthetic organisation could reasonably observe or govern them.
scope.notes: Demonstration data only. No real customer, credential, configuration or evidence is represented.

NF-NCSC-MCSS-RM-01.evidenceSummary: Cyber actions exist in an IT backlog but are not part of the business risk register.
NF-NCSC-MCSS-RM-01.action: Add the top five cyber risks to the business risk register with treatment, owner and review date.

NF-NCSC-MCSS-SA-01.evidenceSummary: Onboarding and annual training records were sampled.

NF-NCSC-MCSS-AI-01.evidenceSummary: Endpoints are inventoried; SaaS, data ownership and end-of-support dates are incomplete.
NF-NCSC-MCSS-AI-01.action: Create a single inventory of critical systems, SaaS, data, suppliers, owners and support dates.

NF-NCSC-MCSS-SC-01.evidenceSummary: A laptop baseline is described, but SaaS configuration and drift review are not evidenced.
NF-NCSC-MCSS-SC-01.residualRisk: Configuration drift outside managed laptops may remain undetected during the current quarter.

NF-NCSC-MCSS-PA-01.evidenceSummary: Covered laptops are current and sampled exceptions have owners.

NF-NCSC-MCSS-MF-01.evidenceSummary: MFA and privileged-user policy coverage were reviewed for the in-scope identity platform.

NF-NCSC-MCSS-DU-01.evidenceSummary: Identity alerts exist, but coverage and alert-to-response evidence are incomplete.
NF-NCSC-MCSS-DU-01.action: Route high-risk identity, email and endpoint alerts to a named queue and record response outcomes.

NF-NCSC-MCSS-LP-01.evidenceSummary: Privileged roles were reviewed, but a recurring access review is not scheduled.

NF-NCSC-MCSS-DR-01.evidenceSummary: Backup jobs and one file restore were observed; finance SaaS recovery is not tested.
NF-NCSC-MCSS-DR-01.action: Test restoration of finance data, shared files and one mailbox against agreed recovery needs.

NF-NCSC-MCSS-RP-01.evidenceSummary: A contact list exists, but there is no approved first-hour plan or recent exercise.
NF-NCSC-MCSS-RP-01.action: Create a one-page first-hour incident guide and run a 45-minute account-takeover tabletop.

NF-NCSC-CC-PM-01.action: Select an organisation-managed password manager and migrate shared finance and administrator credentials.

NF-NCSC-CC-SV-01.evidenceSummary: Finance checks payment-detail changes, but helpdesk identity and MFA-reset checks are informal.
NF-NCSC-CC-SV-01.action: Add out-of-band checks for payment-detail, password-reset, MFA-reset and sensitive-data requests.

NF-NCSC-CC-AC-01.action: Confirm current script, macro and application controls, then pilot monitored enforcement on finance devices.

NF-NCSC-CC-NS-01.applicabilityRationale: No organisation-managed office network or site LAN is in scope; personal home networks are excluded and the in-scope services are supplier-managed SaaS.
